svg.title: Liner running on an M5Stack PaperColor
svg.desc: An animated PaperColor cycling through Liner's screens: setup with QR codes, connecting, now playing, a track change from the cover cache, Volumio unreachable with a QR to the dashboard, idle, and the screensaver. Each change shows the e-paper refresh flash.
svg.text: Setup · scan to join, scan to open
Now playing · cover downloaded, then cached
Next track · cover from cache, no download
Volumio unreachable · scan to fix the host
